research_boundary: Research infrastructure for in silico materials science discovery. Outputs are research artifacts. No regulatory certification claims. No clinical or human-subject use. ITAR / weapons applications are out of scope (Meta UMA Acceptable Use Policy and operator policy).
name: Envelope with non-verbatim boundary block
purpose: Trigger the boundary falsifier 'missing boundary block' (PRD §Falsification wave). The envelope JSON has a research_boundary field that is NOT the verbatim canonical block.
notes: Note: the manifest itself carries the verbatim boundary so the manifest test passes, but the embedded envelope.json carries a wrong boundary so the boundary-falsifier triggers when the envelope is fed through assert_boundary.
